english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications
statement_en: For an irrational number $\alpha$ and any $\varepsilon>0$, there exist infinitely many positive integers $q$ such that $$||q\alpha||<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 对于无理数$\alpha$以及任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在无限多个正整数$q$使得$$||q\alpha||<\varepsilon$$
